body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy adjacent after your movement.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 2 units before rolling. On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage.

surges.html: After a hit, move 1 unit away without triggering that target's movement Reactions.

rider.title: Adaptation - Strider
rider.html: Assume Springs (upkeep 0): your normal Movement may cross a 1-unit gap without a check if you have a clear landing space.
